title: Add testcontainers-go for database tests
notes:
## Context

Currently 27 database-dependent tests require manually running PostgreSQL:
- internal/quotes/integration_test.go - 3 tests
- internal/quotes/store_test.go - 9 tests  
- internal/cache/integration_test.go - 2 tests
- internal/cache/add_test.go - 4 tests
- internal/cache/clean_test.go - 5 tests
- internal/cache/edit_test.go - 4 tests

Current setup uses testutils.NewTestDB(t) which connects to PostgreSQL via environment variables (TEST_DB_HOST, TEST_DB_PORT, etc.).

## Goal

Add testcontainers-go to automatically spin up PostgreSQL containers for tests, eliminating manual database setup.
close_reason: All database tests now pass with testcontainers-go. Fixed Docker dependency version, migration file formats, schemas, and test assertions.
